key_insight: DiaCap jointly learns what was said, when it was said, and which visible speaker said it. Treating utterance timing and speaker identification as connected tasks enables richer audiovisual dialogue captions.
problem_solved: Dialogue captioning requires aligning speech with precise time intervals and identifying speakers visually—tasks that are tightly coupled but difficult to coordinate.
method: Use a single audiovisual large language model to generate each utterance’s transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of its speaker.
Train on 225K curated video clips with synthetic captions that densely annotate utterances.
Apply a second refinement stage; its details are unavailable in the provided, truncated abstract.
impact: DiaCap offers a unified approach to speaker-aware video captioning, with potential applications in accessibility, video indexing, and dialogue analysis. The provided excerpt does not include evaluation results.
